summary: Fixed-seed generalized assignment makes small CVRP route groups using exact capacity-state search.
description:
Input is depot distances, nonnegative demands, a capacity and distinct customer seeds. Output is one group per seed or None if assignment under those seeds is infeasible.

Estimate each customer's extra cost as its least increase to a depot-seed-depot tour. Memoize the best remaining assignment by the customer index and the vector of unused vehicle capacities. A separate routine must order each assigned group.

This search minimizes the assignment surrogate and can be exponential in the number of customers and seeds. An infeasible seeded assignment does not establish that CVRP itself is infeasible.
